verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content at developer.visaacceptance.com/llms.txt, and Visa also publishes an official MCP server (agent-toolkit) confirmed live on npm, giving agents both a machine-readable docs entry point and a programmatic tool interface. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully in practice beyond the HTTP probe.
